name: selfmail
description: Your own mail server inside your dashboard: Postfix and OpenDKIM set up for you, a modern web mail for every domain you own, one-click Cloudflare DNS, and live health — queue, delivery, DNS, blocklists — with warnings on the bell. Bulwark can email you about attack waves through it.
author: Alexd Aero

requires.root: Installs and configures Postfix and OpenDKIM, and runs the web mail as a system service.

actions.label: Fix common problems
actions.confirm: Runs selfmail's doctor as root: it can restart Postfix and OpenDKIM, fix their permissions, and stop a container that holds port 25.

settings.label: Mail domain
settings.help: Only for a new install: the part after the @, e.g. mail.example.com. Add more domains later in the web mail. A selfmail already on this machine is linked as it is.

settings.label: Mailbox name
settings.help: The part before the @. Every other address at your domains lands in the same inbox.

settings.label: Incoming mail
settings.help: relay: a free relay receives on port 25 and posts mail here (works on home connections). direct: this machine receives on port 25 itself.

settings.label: Your full name
settings.help: Signs selfmail's responsible-use agreement (needed for a new install): you're responsible for this server and for following your internet provider's terms.

settings.label: Web mail password (optional)
settings.help: For opening the web mail on its own address, outside this dashboard. Leave empty to make one up; the dashboard never needs it.

update_card.title: {name} {version}
update_card.tagline: Every domain you own in one inbox, inside your dashboard.
highlights: Add as many domains as you like; each signs its own mail
Cloudflare finds your other domains and asks before adding them
Live mail health on the Burrow page, warnings on the bell
Bulwark can email you when an attack wave starts
